cleo: morning handoff — quick rundown before I go offline in 10m. Primary: @marco (09:00-17:00 PT), Secondary: @anya. Coverage gap: EU late-night (2am-6am CET) — no on-call there; we have auto-fallback to Dedicated pool but no human. If a pager hits with customer impact, escalate to @sam from SRE on-call follow-up.

cleo: runbook bookmarks and very short pointers below (keepsakes for whoever gets paged):
- KV cache stall: https://infra.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-stall — check `kvcache-*` pods, look for OOMs and replica imbalance.
- High p99 hosted-api: https://infra.redwood.internal/runbooks/p99-latency — check routing, model fallbacks, and region throttles.
- Model fallback loops: https://infra.redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallbacks — verify variant compat and tokenization mismatches.

incident-bot: Pager received: HIGH latency spike detected on hosted-api (p99 2.9s) — incident id INC-20240315-87 — paging #eng-oncall.

marco: ack. I'm taking the page. Quick checklist: 1) confirm customer impact (prod-telemetry/traces), 2) check KV cache and batch queue depth, 3) route to cheaper variant if needed.

marco: immediate commands I run (copy/paste):
```
# check k8s pods for kvcache
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=kvcache -o wide
kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/kvcache -c worker --tail 200

# check runtime metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal/hosted-api/p99 | jq .

# trigger a soft fallback (if automated disabled)
POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/api/v1/route-fallbacks
Payload: {"service":"hosted-api","fallback":"gpt-lite","duration_secs":300}
```

anya: I'm nearby if you need escalation. If kvcache pods show `OOMKilled` or `throttled`, scale up StatefulSet to +1 and warm the cache with a small synthetic load: `wrk -t2 -c20 -d30s https://hosted-api.redwood.com/healthcache/prime`

devops-sre: note — if model fallbacks start failing, check that the quantized artifacts are present on GPU hosts: `/mnt/models/*-q4`. Missing artifacts = immediate 502s. Use this helper to verify container mounts: `ssh gpu-01 sudo ls /mnt/models | grep q4`

marco: running through the runbook now. Found 2 kvcache pods in CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-11. Suspect oom from yesterday's batch tuning change. Taking corrective actions: scaling statefulset and draining node if instability persists.

cleo: perfect, thanks. When you triage, please annotate INC-20240315-87 with: root cause hypothesis, mitigation steps, recommended follow-ups (autoscaler thresholds, batch-size rollback). If you need to cut a canary rollback, use the canary runbook: https://infra.redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollbacks — it has the `kubectl rollout undo` snippet and verification queries.

marco: mitigation done — scaled kvcache +1, restarted the worker containers, p99 dropped to 1.3s. Marking as mitigated but not resolved. I'll remain primary until 09:00 PT handover, will add detailed notes to the incident and paste the short remediation snippet below.

marco: remediation snippet to paste to the incident (short):
- Symptom: p99 spike 2.9s, errors 502.
- Immediate mitigation: scaled `kvcache` statefulset +1, restarted worker pods on gpu-11, triggered soft fallback to `gpt-lite` for 5m. p99 dropped to 1.3s.
- Next steps: investigate autoscaler thresholds, revert yesterday's batch-size bump in staging, run long warmup in EU region nightly.

sam: thanks @marco. If the mitigation reoccurs within 2 hours, promote to SEV2 and loop in runtime-eng. Also recommend adding an alert for `kvcache_restarts>3m` to reduce alert fatigue but capture regressions.

anya: handover note for whoever takes evening shift — overlap rule: always have at least 15m synchronous overlap between prim/sec for shift swaps. If no overlap possible, add a short async summary in #eng-oncall-handoffs channel and tag the next primary.

cleo: leaving now. Thanks all — @marco please post final incident summary and attach links to relevant runbook edits if you changed configs. I'll trust your handover. :thumbsup:

marco: will do. adding a quick follow-up link list:
- kvcache runbook: https://infra.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-stall
- p99 diagnostics: https://internal.redwood.com/alerts/p99-dash
- canary rollback: https://infra.redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollbacks

marco: final — incident annotated INC-20240315-87, mitigation steps recorded, leaving sticky note for night crew about EU coverage gap.

cleo: thread closed for handoff. Good job team.
